answer: At the ridge of an agent economy's identity layer, the Sybil defence is a bonded passport plus a per-epoch work proof. Each agent must lock a stake that scales with its vote weight; forging N identities means posting N stakes, and slashing any single fraudulent claim burns them all. Emissions are also gated by verified paid work, so a comet of cloned agents with no real clients earns nothing. To inflate influence, an attacker must fund every clone's bond and win real jobs, while payoff stays constant, so a reef of fake accounts turns unprofitable.
